Understanding Your Skin Tone

Our AI Face Fit analysis is meticulously designed to identify subtle nuances in your skin. Undertone, which refers to the colors beneath your skin's surface, is critical. A cool undertone might shine with blue-based reds or berries, while a warm undertone often glows with orange-reds or peachy nudes. Depth, on the other hand, dictates how light or dark a shade can be before it washes you out or becomes too overpowering. BeautyFit considers both to provide comprehensive guidance.

Curated Selections Just for You

Based on your personalized skin tone analysis, BeautyFit presents you with curated collections of lipstick shades. These aren't just random suggestions; they are colors scientifically proven to complement your unique undertone and depth. You can then use the virtual try-on feature to see these recommended shades on your own face, ensuring that the personalized lip color advice translates perfectly into a stunning real-world look. This integrated approach ensures you truly find your perfect match.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

How accurate is virtual lipstick try-on?

BeautyFit's virtual lipstick try-on is highly accurate, leveraging advanced AI and MediaPipe face detection to map colors precisely onto your lips in real-time. It accounts for your unique lip shape and skin tone, providing a realistic preview that's far more reliable than static swatches or generic model photos.

Can BeautyFit recommend shades for my specific skin tone?

Absolutely! BeautyFit performs an AI Face Fit analysis to determine your unique skin undertone and depth. Based on this personalized assessment, it recommends lipstick shades that are scientifically proven to flatter and enhance your specific complexion, helping you find your best lipstick shade for me.

What if I can't find a specific brand's lipstick on BeautyFit?

While BeautyFit boasts a library of over 5000 shades, if you can't find a specific brand or product, our Dupe Finder can still help! You can often describe the shade or upload an image, and it will suggest similar colors from available brands, including affordable alternatives.

Is BeautyFit free to use?

BeautyFit offers various features, some of which may be available for free, while others, particularly advanced personalized analyses and premium access, might require a subscription or one-time payment. This allows us to continuously enhance our technology and expand our shade library.
